# @k2b/ssr (LLM Notes)

Minimal SSR + islands framework for SolidJS on Bun.

## Repository layout

Monorepo root:

- `packages/ssr-core` (library)
- `packages/ssr-example` (current Hono example)

## Core files

- `src/index.ts`
  - `createConfig()`
  - returns `{ config, plugin, html }`
  - injects hydration script
  - production modules use `/_ssr/<buildTimestamp>/<filename>` cache busting; relative lazy imports keep the same module URL

- `src/transform.ts`
  - one Babel transform pass for wrapper injection, TypeScript stripping, and Solid SSR/DOM compilation
  - wraps island/client component usage with `solid-island` / `solid-client`

- `src/island-id.ts`
  - stable file-path-based island IDs
  - avoids collisions across workspace packages

- `src/build.ts`
  - scans island/client files
  - bundles browser chunks into `_ssr`
  - hard-fails on ID collisions
  - emits linked development source maps by default and removes stale generated assets after successful builds

- `src/mount.ts`
  - shared browser mount runtime imported by every generated island/client entry
  - mounts each wrapper element in its own Solid `ErrorBoundary`; props are deserialized inside it
  - default fallback `<div role="alert" data-ssr-error>` with a "Try again" button that remounts
  - dispatches a bubbling, cancelable `ssr:island-error` event (`detail: { error, id, reset }`) and calls `reportError()` unless cancelled
  - optional `createConfig({ errorFallback })` module receives `IslandErrorProps`; protection never depends on it

- `src/adapter/*`
  - Bun, Hono, Elysia adapters
  - serve built chunks from `config.ssrPath`
  - stream `Bun.file` assets with immutable production caching and validator-based freshness for stable development files
  - the dev reload client uses Web Locks to elect one visible cross-tab SSE owner per SSR path, falls back to visibility-scoped per-tab streams, and resumes after `pageshow`

- `src/nav.ts`
  - optional `@k2b/ssr/nav` subpath
  - exports `Link`, `navigate`, `listenPopState`, document navigation helpers, scroll snapshot helpers, and view-transition wrapper
  - not a router; no route matching, loaders, or server page re-rendering
  - apps using `nav.push()` must reconcile island state from `listenPopState()` on Back/Forward
  - `Link` without `onNavigate` keeps native document navigation; enhanced clicks require `onNavigate`
  - same-document hashes retain native scrolling; relative URLs follow `document.baseURI`
  - cross-origin targets and failed async navigation fall back to document navigation

## Conventions

- `*.island.tsx`: SSR + hydrated
- `*.client.tsx`: client-only
- `*.tsx`: server-only

## Monorepo support

`createConfig({ rootDir })` controls:

- island discovery root in build/dev
- dev `/_ssr` directory used by adapters

Use this when entrypoint package differs from island package location.

`createConfig({ componentRoots })` replaces discovery with explicit directories.
Relative paths resolve against `rootDir`; absolute package paths are supported.
Omit the option to scan `rootDir`; `[]` selects nothing. Missing roots fail.
Canonical paths deduplicate overlapping and symlinked roots. Nested node_modules
and .git directories are excluded; installed packages must be selected explicitly.
`rootDir` remains authoritative for IDs and the development asset directory.
Ordinary browser/SSR component libraries are bundled through imports, not scanned.
Use the same selection for development and production.

## Hono helper

`createSSRHandler(html)` enables pages as:

```tsx
export default ssr(async (c) => {
  c.get("page").title = "Home";
  return () => <Page />;
});
```

Supports middlewares/validators before final handler.

## Rendering API migration

Since v0.9.0, `html()` and Hono `ssr()` handlers require synchronous render functions.

Use:

```tsx
export default ssr(async () => () => <Page />);
app.get("/", () => html(() => <Page />));
```

Do not use the pre-v0.9.0 direct JSX style:

```tsx
export default ssr(async () => <Page />);
app.get("/", () => html(<Page />));
```

Reason: JSX must be created inside `renderToString()` so Solid SSR context exists for primitives such as `createUniqueId()`. Async work belongs in the handler before returning `() => <Page />`; the render function itself must stay synchronous.

## Local example app

See `packages/ssr-example` for the current reference setup.

`/nav-demo` demonstrates `@k2b/ssr/nav`: same-origin links update
client state and browser history while preserving island state and keyed scroll
regions. It also restores its active view from `popstate` on Back/Forward.

Useful workspace commands (from repo root):

```bash
bun run test
bun run dev:example
bun run build:example
```
